What session 1 can give you

An example for one hard moment: leaving for school.

  1. Firstshoes and bag
  2. Thencar
  3. Afterschool

Your script: “Shoes and bag first. Then car.” Same words, same card, every morning. Point to it, show it, or say it.

An example only. Every plan is made with your family, for your child and your home.

Notes after every session, with WhatsApp support in between.

CJ’s promise

  • Nothing is paid before session 1. You can pay in 3 parts.
  • Session 1 not right? Tell CJ within 7 days and pay nothing.
  • Plan not usable by session 4? Up to 2 extra sessions, then a full refund.

Questions? Good.

What’s included in Parent Coaching?
  • 4 one-to-one online sessions over 6 weeks (weeks 1, 2, 4 and 6)
  • One session can be just for your partner, helper or grandparent, in English or Bahasa Malaysia
  • A visual support and script for one hard moment, the first version within 2 working days of session 1
  • Notes after every session
  • WhatsApp support with replies the same working day, for the 6 weeks and a settling month after
  • Your written plan within 48 hours of the last session
  • With your written consent, a short note to your child’s therapists and school
  • If the plan is not usable at home by session 4, up to 2 more sessions at no cost
How much does it cost?

CJ confirms fit first, then shares fees privately. Nothing is paid before your first session. If session 1 is not right for you, tell CJ within 7 days and you pay nothing. After that, you only pay for the parts you have started.

Is this therapy?

No. APC is parent education. It works with your child’s therapists, not instead of them.

Do we need a diagnosis?

No. You can book the free call or join Parent Coaching whether or not your child has a diagnosis, or while you are waiting for one.

What do I prepare for the call?

Nothing. Think of one moment that keeps repeating.
